reuse.why: Reuses recurrence conversion and weekend movement helpers, but repeats occurrence filtering and adjustment orchestration across consumers.

duplication.why: Holiday matching is centralized and budget-loop repetition is reduced, but daily filtering and effective-date selection remain duplicated.

placement.why: Most date policy stays in shared/schedules.ts, although the server handlers also own parts of that policy and its search bounds.

scope.why: All edits support the requested schedule rules, range handler, configuration, or related tests.

maintainability.why: The small helpers are understandable, but maintaining consistent scheduling policy requires coordinating multiple enumeration pipelines.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange enumerate raw occurrences and reconstruct policy handled by shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes getUpcomingDates' daily-versus-moving branch into successive filter/map operations while retaining the same policy decisions.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently orchestrate filtering and movement.
